name: automation-code-extractor
description: Chrome/Edge MV3 extension that captures Pabbly Connect workflows and Zapier Zaps and exports a clean schema for AI code conversion.

scripts.check: node -e "const{readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs'),{join}=require('path'),{execSync}=require('child_process'),walk=d=>readdirSync(d).flatMap(f=>{const p=join(d,f);return statSync(p).isDirectory()?walk(p):p.endsWith('.js')?[p]:[]});const fs=walk('src');const bad=[];for(const f of fs){try{execSync('node --check '+f,{stdio:['ignore','ignore','pipe']})}catch(e){const L=String(e.stderr).split('\n').filter(Boolean);bad.push(f+' -> '+(L[0]||'?')+' :: '+(L.find(l=>/Error/.test(l))||'unknown'))}}if(bad.length){console.error('SYNTAX CHECK FAILED ('+bad.length+'/'+fs.length+')');bad.forEach(b=>console.error('  '+b));process.exit(1)}console.log('syntax check OK — '+fs.length+' files')"
